- Camila (AE) — product/rollout owner
- Dylan (SE) — technical kickoff & integration lead

1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Pilot objectives & success criteria (15m)
3) Network/KMS/security checklist & evidence handoff (20m)
4) Environment & access plan (20m)
5) Timeline, milestones, owners (20m)
6) Q&A & next steps (10m)

Can you confirm two windows next week that work for the cross-functional group? Ill attach the draft runbook and SOC request matrix for pre-read.

Pre-reads attached: POC-Runbook-v0.6.pdf, SOC2-Evidence-Request.xlsx

- Legal: Camila, can you copy procurement on the DPA/NDA diff?

Proposed calendar slot: Tue Aug 11, 10:30–12:00 PT (90m) — this keeps the team together and gives us time for the security checklist. Ill bring the runbook and a short demo of the private endpoint.
